faqs.question: What is W.I.S.E.C.E.O.?
faqs.answer: W.I.S.E.C.E.O. (Worldwide Institute For Success And Excellence) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit headquartered in West Chester, Ohio. It creates equity and opportunity through digital literacy, workforce development, literacy and language access, and economic mobility for underserved communities.

faqs.question: Who does W.I.S.E.C.E.O. serve?
faqs.answer: Refugees and immigrants, including newcomer families and English learners; underserved students of high school age and older; underserved women and girls; veterans; and first-generation and low-income youth and adults seeking economic mobility.

faqs.question: What programs does W.I.S.E.C.E.O. offer?
faqs.answer: The WISECEO Academy Career Fellowship, a no-cost fellowship for grades 9–12 in cybersecurity, energy and infrastructure, and AI, plus Digital Literacy & Coding, Workforce Development, Entrepreneurship & Innovation, the Youth Leadership Academy, Education Access & Equity, and Community Economic Resilience.

faqs.question: How do I apply to a program?
faqs.answer: Complete the application at wiseceo.org/apply. Applicants under 18 need a parent or guardian to complete or co-sign the application. Applying does not sign you up for the newsletter.

faqs.question: Where does W.I.S.E.C.E.O. work?
faqs.answer: W.I.S.E.C.E.O. is headquartered in West Chester, Ohio, with chapters in Kentucky, Florida and Mississippi and impact across 35 nations. It has reached more than 25,000 students to date.

faqs.question: Are donations tax-deductible?
faqs.answer: Yes. W.I.S.E.C.E.O. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 41-3404888), and donations are tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. You can become a member for $4.99 a month or give once at wiseceo.org/give.
